Excellent screen protector! Crystal clear and easy to install. No bubbles at all. The 9H hardness is legit - dropped my phone and no cracks on the protector. Great value for a 3-pack.

Good fingerprint resistant coating on this protector. My screen stays much cleaner compared to my old protector. The oleophobic layer really works well. Installation was easy with the included guide. Highly recommend for anyone wanting good fingerprint resistant protection.
